verdict.rationale: CDP is API-first, so it runs headlessly by design. Treasury and payout flows can be driven entirely from the official CDP CLI or SDK, which also includes an MCP server exposing every endpoint as a tool. A fully isolated Sandbox lets automated test runs exercise custodial features without real funds, and webhooks deliver event notifications programmatically. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance (non-interactive auth, API-key handling in pipelines), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
